content_metadata.description: This video provides an overview of Ericsson's sustainability efforts, focusing on their approach to sustainability, commitment to reducing environmental impact, and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

activities.description: Speaker introducing Ericsson's approach to sustainability
Speaker introducing UN Sustainable Development Goals

characterInteraction.description: The speaker addresses the audience directly, aiming to engage them in the topic of sustainability at Ericsson.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The speaker emphasizes that Ericsson's commitment to sustainability is rooted in their long history and aligns with their company purpose of 'innovating technology for good.' (1:37-2:07)

keyMoments.changeDescription: Change in visual from a blurry background to a sharp and colorful one.
Engaging visual representation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals, generating curiosity.
Smiling expression appears on the speaker's face as she introduces the UN goals.

narrativeProgression.description: The speaker introduces Ericsson's three-pronged approach to sustainability: responsible business, energy/environment/climate action, and internet for all.
The speaker focuses on Ericsson's commitment to reducing their own emissions and improving the energy performance of their products.
The speaker shifts to the framework Ericsson uses for sustainability - the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
The UN Sustainable Development Goals are displayed visually, with emphasis on goals related to water, responsible production and consumption, agriculture, and partnerships.

Matilda Genvi Gustafsson introduces the Sustainability Talks @Ericsson 2018.

This talk is from Ericsson Sustainability talks in Gothenburg, during Volvo Ocean Race 19-20 June 2018.
